name: Francesco Guerra
bio: Francesco Guerra is a Full Professor at the Department of Engineering "Enzo Ferrari" of the University of Modena and Reggio Emilia. He leads the SoftLab research group and has over 20 years of experience in data management, information retrieval, and machine learning. His research focuses on entity matching, data integration, and knowledge graph construction.

name: Matteo Paganelli
bio: Matteo Paganelli is a PhD student and research fellow at SoftLab. His research focuses on applying deep learning and pre-trained language models (such as BERT) to the entity matching problem in databases and data integration pipelines.

name: Paolo Sottovia
bio: Paolo Sottovia is a research fellow at SoftLab working on time series analysis, anomaly detection, and big data processing. He contributes to projects involving streaming data analytics and scalable machine learning pipelines.

name: Francesco Pagliacci
bio: Francesco Pagliacci is a research fellow at SoftLab. His work involves data integration, entity resolution, and the development of evaluation frameworks for unsupervised dataset integration methods.

name: Francesco Del Buono
bio: Francesco Del Buono is a PhD student at SoftLab. His doctoral research explores the intersection of machine learning and database systems, with a focus on integrating ML inference capabilities directly within database query engines.

name: Sara Pederzoli
bio: Sara Pederzoli is a PhD student at SoftLab. Her research focuses on natural language processing applied to financial documents, specifically on extracting and analyzing ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) information from corporate reports and filings.

name: Michele Luca Contalbo
bio: Michele Luca Contalbo is a research fellow at SoftLab. He works on fact verification, misinformation detection, and the development of systems for assessing the factual accuracy of claims made in text documents.
